Continue the existing preview-only readiness packets for the parked scaffold sites. Preserve parked/private status and record dated ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement, rollback, and blocker evidence. Do not publish, deploy, alter DNS, configure analytics, monetize, spend, add dependencies, or create queue work.

Continue the existing read-only security evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Preserve private launch gates and block security-sensitive releases. Do not access credentials or private containers, change permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, exploit targets, or conduct outreach.

Material concerns are full delivery capacity, measurement backlog, failed and stranded work, unavailable operations/security evidence, incomplete attribution, and missing matching-period costs. Preserve unavailable values as unknown; do not treat them as zero or infer financial performance.
